newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ReliaStar buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ReliaStar buy repeated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst J. Chris Sergeant on Monday said he reiterated a buy rating on ReliaStar Financial Corp.
-- Earlier, ReliaStar announced a $488 million agreement to acquire Security-Connecticut Corp.
-- The deal is expected to be non-dilutive to earnings in 1997 and modestly accretive in 1998.

-- "We view the transaction as a good strategic fit for ReliaStar," Sergeant said in a report. "We feel confident that ReliaStar management will be able to integrate the two companies and eliminate redundant costs."
-- He said earnings estimates were under review, though he expected no major revision to his 1997 forecast of $5.10 a share.
-- Sergeant said his 1998 estimate of $5.75 a share may be revised "modestly updward."
